content.short: Synthetix enables the issuance of synthetic real-world assets on the Ethereum blockchain.
content.description: Synthetix, founded in 2017 by Kain Warwick, is a DeFi platform that provides on-chain exposure to traditional assets like gold and silver. The protocol uses price oracles to peg synthetic assets to their real-world counterparts, enabling crypto users to access traditional assets through blockchain technology. Since then, Synthetix expanded to the Optimism L2 network and now accounts for over half of all recorded synthetic asset TVL.

resources.title: Introducing TWAP Orders on Synthetix Perps
resources.tldr: Time-weighted average price orders exist because pushing size through in one go moves the market against you. A clear explanation of scaling in and out over time.

resources.title: Introducing Scaled Orders on Synthetix Perps
resources.tldr: Rather than one large limit at a single level, a scaled order lays a ladder across a range. Useful for understanding how execution shape changes your average fill.

resources.title: Introducing ETH as Margin on Synthetix
resources.tldr: The first non-stable asset accepted as collateral, which sounds simple and is not: posting a volatile asset as margin changes how liquidation has to work.
